concerns.text: The phrase “sufficient number of iterations” is vague; a concrete minimum (e.g., ≥1000 permutations) is required to make the p‑value measurable and reproducible.
Same vagueness as SC‑002 – the requirement to “execute a permutation test with a sufficient number of iterations” lacks a quantitative threshold, preventing a deterministic test.

The clause “ensuring all available valid entries are collected” is not operationally defined; testability requires a clear metric (e.g., “the script must retrieve ≥ 95 % of entries returned by the API after applying the amorphous filter”).
The fallback behavior when *all* descriptors are dropped due to VIF > 5.0 is unspecified, leaving a potential dead‑end that cannot be verified as passing or failing.

concerns.location: Edge Cases – dataset size exceeds 7 GB RAM
concerns.text: The sampling strategy is mentioned but not quantified (e.g., “randomly sample to ≤ 10 000 rows”); without a concrete rule the test cannot confirm the constraint is respected.
